say:3:1120619001:1.source_cn: 药膏敷上之后，感觉怎么样？

say:4:1120619002:1.text: The sting is starting to cool down... Hey, I can feel my hands again!
say:4:1120619002:1.source_cn: 伤口处清清凉凉……哦，我的手有知觉了！

say:5:1120619003:1.text: I feel less dizzy now, too... Looks like it's working pretty well.
say:5:1120619003:1.source_cn: 眩晕感也减轻了许多……看来，很有效果。

choice_prompt:6:1120619003.text: I feel less dizzy now, too... Looks like it's working pretty well.
choice_prompt:6:1120619003.source_cn: 眩晕感也减轻了许多……看来，很有效果。

say:7:1120619004:1.text: Of course! The heroes always have to go through a few hardships before they can emerge victorious!
say:7:1120619004:1.source_cn: 当然！戏剧中的主人翁，在成功之前都要经历一番艰辛。

say:8:1120619005:1.text: "To appreciate the beauty of the peak, you must scale the mountain you seek."
say:8:1120619005:1.source_cn: “要欣赏山巅美景，需先行过崎岖的山路”。
say:8:1120619005:1.male: "To appreciate the beauty of the peak, you must scale the mountain you seek."
say:8:1120619005:1.female: "To appreciate the beauty of the peak, you must scale the mountain you seek."

say:9:1120619006:1.text: No one wants to listen to a story with no danger... And as the heroes of this story, Oldiler and I have an obligation to make it exciting!
say:9:1120619006:1.source_cn: 太顺利的故事无法吸引观众——而这出寻宝历险记，我和欧迪...
say:9:1120619006:1.male: No one wants to listen to a story with no danger... And as the heroes of this story, Oldiler and I have an obligation to make it exciting!
say:9:1120619006:1.female: No one wants to listen to a story with no danger... And as the heroes of this story, Oldiler and I have an obligation to make it exciting!

say:10:1120619007:1.text: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
say:10:1120619007:1.source_cn: 说起来，我竟然开始慢慢喜欢这里了……这让我自己都难以想象。
say:10:1120619007:1.male: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
say:10:1120619007:1.female: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.

choice_prompt:11:1120619007.text: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
choice_prompt:11:1120619007.source_cn: 说起来，我竟然开始慢慢喜欢这里了……这让我自己都难以想象。
choice_prompt:11:1120619007.male: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.
choice_prompt:11:1120619007.female: I can hardly believe it, but I have to say... I'm starting to like it out here.

say:12:1120619008:1.text: I don't like being far away from home. Maybe it's because of our father's disappearance...
say:12:1120619008:1.source_cn: 我不喜欢远离家乡的感觉。或许是因为父亲失踪的缘故……
say:12:1120619008:1.male: I don't like being far away from home. Maybe it's because of our father's disappearance...
say:12:1120619008:1.female: I don't like being far away from home. Maybe it's because of our father's disappearance...

say:13:1120619009:1.text: But after our run-ins with bandits and poisonous scorpions, I realized something important. We'd never have experienced any of this if we had just stayed home.
say:13:1120619009:1.source_cn: 但来到这里才发现，虽然经历了匪徒和毒蝎，但如果蜗居在家...
say:13:1120619009:1.male: But after our run-ins with bandits and poisonous scorpions, I realized something important. We'd never have experienced any of this if we had just stayed home.
say:13:1120619009:1.female: But after our run-ins with bandits and poisonous scorpions, I realized something important. We'd never have experienced any of this if we had just stayed home.

say:14:1120619010:1.text: Being far from home isn't as scary as I thought. In fact, it's even a little exciting.
say:14:1120619010:1.source_cn: 远方并没有想象中的那么可怕。甚至可以说，很有趣。
say:14:1120619010:1.male: Being far from home isn't as scary as I thought. In fact, it's even a little exciting.
say:14:1120619010:1.female: Being far from home isn't as scary as I thought. In fact, it's even a little exciting.

say:17:1120619012:1.text: Me? I'm more excited about finding that buried treasure, and what we'll do with it after bringing it home.
say:17:1120619012:1.source_cn: 我？我更期待从这片沙漠之下挖出宝藏后的事情——就像我之...

say:18:1120619013:1.text: "Though the brothers saw many wonderful things along the way, what captivated them most was reaching home to stay!"
say:18:1120619013:1.source_cn: “相比于路途中偶尔的美景，终点才是令他魂牵梦绕的彼方！”

say:19:1120619014:1.text: Also... this is a chance for us to find our father. Even though he left without a word... I still miss him.
say:19:1120619014:1.source_cn: 而且……这也是我们找到父亲的契机。虽然他没留下只言片语...

say:20:1120619015:1.text: So do I, Oldiler. In all of the stories he told us, the heroes always chose their path and their destination.
say:20:1120619015:1.source_cn: 我也是，哥哥。无数的故事告诉我们：选择了一条路的同时，...

say:21:1120619016:1.text: We may be a little battered and dizzy, but our choice is still the same. We'll keep going!
say:21:1120619016:1.source_cn: 而现在，我的头虽然还有些晕，但我还是选择——继续前进！

choice:11:1:2.text: You don't like the Eroded Enclave?
choice:11:1:2.male: You don't like the Eroded Enclave?
choice:11:1:2.female: You don't like the Eroded Enclave?

choice:6:0:1.text: Are you going to keep searching for the treasure?
choice:6:0:1.male: Are you going to keep searching for the treasure?
choice:6:0:1.female: Are you going to keep searching for the treasure?
